title: Vesper and the Room
author: Orsen Almeida
blurb: Ansel Ashgrove, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, has spent fifteen years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the well refills.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
